callees.name: is_cli_backend_enabled
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the LLM backend is configured as codex-cli or claude-cli; returns False for any other backend configuration value. No side effects.

callees.name: _load_ignored
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a path to an existing directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns the set of check_id strings that were previously persisted as ignored in the ignored-checks file under work_dir. Returns an empty set if the ignored-checks file does not exist or contains no entries. No side effects — does not create or modify the file.

callees.name: _check_llm_api_key
callees.pre_condition: config provides access to the llm.api_key configuration field.
callees.post_condition: Returns (True, None) when the configured LLM API key is non-empty and not a placeholder value. Returns (False, error_message) when the API key is empty, unset, or appears to be a placeholder. No side effects.

callees.name: _check_oh_my_openagent
callees.post_condition: Returns (True, None) when oh-my-openagent is reachable via bunx and responds within 10 seconds. Returns (False, error_message) when bunx cannot invoke oh-my-openagent for any reason. No side effects.

callees.name: _check_comment_checker
callees.post_condition: Returns (True, None) when the comment-checker hook is disabled in the oh-my-openagent configuration. Returns (False, error_message) when the hook is enabled or the configuration file cannot be read. No side effects.

callees.name: _check_codegraph_version
callees.pre_condition: config provides access to the pinned codegraph version and binary location configuration.
callees.post_condition: Returns (True, None) when the codegraph binary is installed at the pinned version specified in config. Returns (False, error_message) when the binary is not found, not executable, or its version does not match the pinned version. No side effects.

callees.name: is_interactive
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the process's standard input is connected to a terminal (TTY); returns False otherwise. No side effects.

callees.name: _save_ignored
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a path to an existing directory. ignored_set is a set of check_id strings.
callees.post_condition: Persists every check_id in ignored_set to the ignored-checks file under work_dir. Creates the file if it does not exist; overwrites it if it does. The function does not signal errors to the caller — failures are silent.
